justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/Throw.java` (46 lines) and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/ThrowTest.java`. The class is a singleton enum with only two concrete behaviors: `isValid()` always returns `true`, and `apply(...)` emits `Opcodes.ATHROW` and returns `StackSize.SINGLE.toDecreasingSize()`. This is a narrow, single-purpose stack manipulation with no sign of excessive methods, mixed responsibilities, or low cohesion, so insufficient modularization is not present.
